title: filter not being properly applied in federated search
body:
**Describe the bug 🐛**
A facet filter is not applied to another index.

**To Reproduce 🔍**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:

1. Go to https://codesandbox.io/s/ais-ecommerce-demo-app-6hxt7
2. Click "blue" on the refinement list
3. Confirm there're non-blue items on `banners` index.

**Expected behavior 💭**
There should be only "blue" items.

**Screenshots 🖥**

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/499898/69816933-b76b1a80-11f9-11ea-89a7-0c3da7449e90.png)

**Environment:**
N/A

**Additional context**

```
ㄴ index `products`
    ㄴ index `products`
        ㄴ refinementList
        ㄴ hits
    ㄴ index `banners`
        ㄴ hits
```

When "blue" is refined, it should apply to all the indices.
